remarks: Welcome Home! This house is conveniently located walking distance to Stew Leonards, restaurants, Starbucks, and other shopping! Located on a tree lined street this home features an open floor plan with kitchen, livingroom, dining room and one bedroom on the first floor as well as a half bath. The second floor has two additional bedrooms and full bath. In the lower level you will find a finished room that could be used as a gym, media room or rec room as well as a full bathroom. The rear yard is fully fenced with a patio. Lovely home close to everything!
